newsitem.title: CANADA: Exall completes gold drill program.
newsitem.headline: Exall completes gold drill program.

text.p: Exall Resources Ltd said on Tuesday it has completed a 2,000-metre drill program at its Glimmer gold site in Northern Ontario.
Drill results were positive, with more than 80 percent of the drill holes striking ore grade mineralization over minable widths, Exall said in a statement.
Since the results were positive, the company has decided to add three drill rigs to the site and extend its drill program indefinitely.
A new reserve calculation will be completed in February and is expected to increase minable reserves, Exall said.

The latest calculation set reserves at 500,000 tonnes of ore grading 11.5 grams of gold per tonne. The overall resource is estimated at 1.3 million tonnes of ore containing 441,000 ounces, company chairman Stephen Roman said in a phone interview.
The continuing drill program is designed to extend the down dip extension of minable reserves and to test other magnetic anomalies.
